Qubic Carpentry Services - A Home Renovation Company
A family-run home renovation company, based in Birmingham. An experienced carpenter specialising in kitchen and bathroom fitting, with expertise in bespoke furniture and joinery.

From handmade kitchen cabinets to bespoke larders, we can help you create a kitchen that you can be proud of. Our skilled craftsmen specialise in handmade bespoke kitchen cabinets in a traditional or shaker style, crafted in our joinery workshop.

From concept and design to full strip-out and complete redecoration. We have a vast experience dealing with a range of products and materials and can provide a luxury finish to wet rooms, shower rooms and bathrooms.
Boxing in pipes, building fitted cupboards and upgrading the woodwork in your home.
